name: Edu Solar System XR
summary:
Edu Solar System XR is an interactive educational experience that brings the Solar System into virtual and mixed reality.

Explore the Sun and planets in 3D, observe their relative positions and orbital motion, and inspect celestial bodies up close using hand tracking or Touch controllers. Grab selected objects, examine them from different angles, and return them to their orbit when finished.
